newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lucent sees fast growth in Asia-Pacific.
newsitem.headline: Lucent sees fast growth in Asia-Pacific.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said on Tuesday it expects to grow faster than the telecommunications market and its competitors in upcoming years, and the biggest growth should come from the Asia-Pacific region.

"We are projecting growth of US$100 billion over the next three years (in the industry)," said David Johnson, regional vice president at Lucent Technologies Business Communications Systems, Asia/Pacific and China.
"It is our expectation that we will grow faster than the market and faster than our competitors," he told reporters in Hong Kong.

Johnson said Lucent's business communications systems business was growing at a rate of 45 percent in the Asia-Pacific region, with expectations to grow at a rate of 60 percent by the end of the year.
"Lucent globally for the same business in growing at eight percent," he said.
"Growth in Asia Pacific is the biggest growth in the world for us," Johnson added.
